entries.description: Workspace-specific exact-phrase trigger for showing reminders for a configured user. Stays in deterministic-responses.json because the phrase embeds a workspace-specific user ID (<@USER1_ID>) that cannot be expressed as a generic catalog RegexAlias. Operators replace SLEUTH_APP_ID and USER1_ID with real Slack IDs for their workspace.
Health probe / connectivity test. Stays here as a true canned response — not a command, not RMM-discoverable by design.
